snippet.title: CHARNEL – Announcement Trailer | Real-Time ASCII Roguelike Shooter
snippet.description:
Wishlist CHARNEL on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5351830/CHARNEL/

Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike, you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

Coming 2027 to Windows, macOS and Linux.

Follow development:
X: https://x.com/scottraywilson

#CHARNEL #roguelike #indiegame #ASCII #gamedev
